chore(testing): remove the e2e-signoff hook (candybar-testing-ihvy.ums) (#745)

* chore(testing): remove the e2e-signoff hook; the sign-off file and the cap and assertion checks stay (candybar-testing-ihvy.ums)

The hook refused any tool call whose text named a guarded path, read-only
ones included, so it blocked agents' ordinary work. The checks it guarded
are what CI enforces, and they are unchanged.

* chore(testing): drop the removed hook from the required-CI-steps comment (candybar-testing-ihvy.ums)
